traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Feelings meet imagination and dissolution. A need for escape and reverie, high sensitivity, and compassion. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of feeling and imagination is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Strong for imaginative work; protect boundaries and energy.
shadow: Moodiness and over-need fused with illusion and escapism, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.
base: When emotion is high, the atmosphere can start feeling like a more reliable account of events than the facts themselves.

readerCopy.body: When emotion is high, the atmosphere can start feeling like a more reliable account of events than the facts themselves. When the Moon conjoins Neptune, feelings spread quickly and the boundary between personal reaction, empathy, and what has been absorbed from others becomes less clear. Compassion can be genuine alongside confusion. A little time can reveal which feelings still belong to the situation after the collective mood changes.
